packages.title: A voice move of a task with only a deadline moves its deadline (D1)
brief: Context: run 2026-10-21-changes, plan 2. You carry out the owner's D1 of 2026-10-21 (evening), answered as recommended (DECISIONS.md, «Bulk commands: D1–D3»): a voice move to a day, for a set («pasa todo lo de ayer a mañana») or for one task, moves the deadline of a task that has only a deadline, as a move by days already does; a time said for such a task goes on its deadline too (UX-1709's fifth item, which this package carries); voice only, so Calendar's own «Cambiar fecha» keeps its rule. The contract already says so (Backend/docs/VOICE_COMMANDS.md, `changes`, the `date` and `time` rows, 8e4513f). P232 and P233 build on this package.

UX-1715 (S2, review A's Q1). `planUpdate` (App/lib/services/command_plan.dart:204-347) sets a new planned day from `changes.date` for every task (:225-244), so a task with only a deadline gets a planned day and keeps its old deadline. «Pasa todas las tareas de ayer a mañana» listed «Pagar la factura del gas · Vence mar, 20 oct» under «Mover 4 tareas a mañana, jue 22» (render cards.bulk-move), and after the tap it sat on Thursday reading «Vence mar, 20 oct · Fecha límite vencida», in red (applied.bulk-applied): «Le he dicho que la pase a mañana… ¿por qué sigue en rojo, vencida?». Meanwhile «retrásalo todo un día» moves the same task's deadline (:246-254), so two ways of saying «move it» give two results. A time alone («a las 18:00») on such a task needs a day (`needsDay`, :239-241): one task asks «¿Qué día, a las 18:00?», and a set counts it under «sin fecha» (`noDayTasks`, App/lib/services/bulk_plan.dart:207), though its row shows «Vence …».

Fix, in `planUpdate`, one rule for a task with only a deadline: its card shows no planned day (`planned`, :217, is null) and it has a deadline (`due`, :218). Unless the change also names the deadline (`deadline_date` or `deadline_time`: then those apply as now, and `date` sets the planned day, as the shift branch already checks at :249-253): (1) `date` with a day moves the deadline to that day, keeping the deadline's time, or taking the time said with it (`time`), and no planned day is set; (2) `time` with a time, and no `date`, sets that time on the deadline's own day, and `needsDay` stays false; (3) `shift_days` moves the deadline, as now. Fold the existing shift branch (:249-254) into this one rule, and skip the planned-day block (:225-244) for such a task whenever the rule applies. `_same` still drops a deadline already as asked, so the card says «Ya está así.». `date: null` and `time: null` stay as they are now: they take away a planned day or time, which this task doesn't have. A task with a planned day, with or without a deadline, is unchanged (the move sets its planned day and keeps its deadline); repeating tasks always have a planned day, so they're unaffected. `UpdatePlan.after()` (:132-148) already keeps the reminder on the deadline when the task has no day.

Add to `UpdatePlan` a flag (for example `movesDeadline`) that is true when the deadline moved in place of the planned day, by this rule or by days. The screen uses it. `_onlyMoved` (App/lib/screens/voice_task_screen.dart:378-385) counts only `schedule` as a move, so today a task with only a deadline moved by voice reads «Guardar cambios» and then «Tarea cambiada», where a planned task reads «Cambiar fecha» and then «Movida al vie, 23 oct». Treat a plan with the flag, and no other change, as a move: the button (:4261-4268) reads `reschedule` («Cambiar fecha» / “Reschedule” / «Canvia la data»), and the message names the deadline's new day: `moving` (:3663) is then the new deadline, used at :3699 and :3714-3719 with `movedOccurrenceDate` («Movida al {date}» / “Moved to {date}” / «Moguda al {date}»), so «Movida al vie, 23 oct». No new copy. A move by days of one such task gets the same words.

Sets need nothing more. `planBulk` (bulk_plan.dart:194-216) calls `planUpdate`, so a set moved to a day moves its deadline-only tasks' deadlines; a time said for a set puts it on their deadlines and lists them; only tasks with neither a day nor a deadline are left out as «sin fecha» (`noDayTasks`). `movesOnly` (:129-133), the message «N tareas movidas al …» and the landing (`landing`, voice_task_screen.dart:3644: a task with only a deadline lands on its deadline's day) already work. Before the tap, the set row keeps showing the deadline as it is («Vence mié, 21 oct»).

Don't touch: Calendar's own «Cambiar fecha» (App/lib/widgets/task_interactions.dart:49, `editSchedule` with `moving`) and the task form, which keep giving such a task a planned day (D1 is voice only); the change card (App/lib/widgets/capture_command_cards.dart:1352-1414), which already draws `plan.deadline` as its own line, «Fecha límite: mié, 21 oct → Mañana» (TalkBack: `commandChangeSemantics`); `time: null` on a task with only a deadline (unchanged: the contract's D1 line covers a time said); the contract.

Tests your change rightly breaks, in App/test/bulk_voice_commands_test.dart: 'a day for the set moves each task there, keeping its time' (:604-619) pins the old rule for task 7 («Solo con fecha límite»): now it keeps no planned day and its deadline is day(1); 'a time for tasks with no day leaves them out, counted; what is already as asked isn’t listed' (:576-590): task 7 now takes 18:00 on its deadline and is listed, and `noDay` is 1. Search App/test for other tests that expect a planned day, «Sin fecha → …» or «¿Qué día…?» on a task with only a deadline.

Previews: re-render commands/. applied.bulk-applied now shows «Pagar la factura del gas» on tomorrow reading «Vence vie, 23 oct», without «Fecha límite vencida»: update its description. Add `cards.change-deadline-only` (es 1×, es 2×): «Pasa la factura del gas a mañana» for a task with only yesterday's deadline: one change line, the deadline's, «mié, 21 oct → Mañana», and the button «Cambiar fecha».
acceptance: One task, Spanish, 1× on 360×800: «Pasa la factura del gas a mañana» for «Pagar la factura del gas», which has only a deadline (yesterday, no time) and no planned day: the card has one change line, the deadline's, reading «<yesterday> → Mañana» (TalkBack: «Fecha límite: de <yesterday> a Mañana»), and no «Fecha y hora» line; the button reads «Cambiar fecha».

Then the tap: the task still has no planned day and its deadline is tomorrow; Calendar lands on tomorrow with the task's row lit and no «Fecha límite vencida» on it; the message reads «Movida al <tomorrow, weekdayDate>» with Deshacer; Deshacer puts the deadline back on yesterday.

One task, Spanish: «Pon la factura del gas a las 18:00» for the same task: no «¿Qué día, a las 18:00?» question; the deadline line reads «<yesterday> → <yesterday> · 18:00»; after the tap the deadline is yesterday at 18:00, with its time, and the task still has no planned day.
A deadline's time is kept: a task with only a deadline, yesterday at 9:00, moved «a mañana», ends with its deadline tomorrow at 9:00.

Unchanged: a task with a planned day and a deadline, moved «a mañana», gets tomorrow as its planned day and keeps its deadline; a change that also names the deadline (`date` tomorrow and `deadline_date` next Monday, «pasa la factura a mañana y que venza el lunes») sets the planned day to tomorrow and the deadline to Monday; a task with no day and no deadline, given a time, still asks «¿Qué día, a las 18:00?».

Set, Spanish, 1×: «Pasa todas las tareas de ayer a mañana» over 4 open tasks from yesterday, one of them with only a deadline (yesterday): the heading reads «Mover 4 tareas a mañana, <tomorrow, E d>»; after «Mover 4 tareas», that task has no planned day and its deadline is tomorrow, and the message reads «4 tareas movidas al <tomorrow, weekdayDate>».

Set with no period (`setTarget()`, «Pon todas mis tareas a las 18:00») over a task with only a deadline and a task with neither a day nor a deadline: the first is listed and, after the tap, has 18:00 on its deadline; the line after the list names only the other («<title> no tiene fecha: no cambia»).
Calendar's own Cambiar fecha on a task with only a deadline still gives it a planned day and keeps the deadline: the existing tests of task_interactions pass unchanged.
deviceChecks: Main session, real model: «Pasa la factura del gas a mañana» and «Pon la factura del gas a las 18:00», said for a task with only a deadline, come back as a `date` change and a `time` change, and the card shows the deadline line as in the widget tests.

packages.title: «Hoy» takes the overdue tasks Today lists, first and marked «Atrasada» (D2)
brief: Context: run 2026-10-21-changes, plan 2. You carry out the owner's D2 of 2026-10-21 (evening), «Yes, include overdue» (DECISIONS.md, «Bulk commands: D1–D3»): a set whose period is exactly today (`from` = `to` = today) also takes the open tasks Today lists under «Atrasadas», listed first with «Atrasada» and ticked, so any can be unticked. The contract says it (Backend/docs/VOICE_COMMANDS.md, «Which tasks the set holds», «Hoy», 8e4513f): for pending sets only, so it never adds to «las completadas de hoy». Builds on P231 (a set moved to a day moves a deadline-only task's deadline).

UX-1702 (S2). `TaskMatcher.bulk` (App/lib/services/task_matcher.dart:312-414) drops every task dated before `from` (:374), and a one-day completion takes only that day's repetitions (:350-361). Since the owner's D1 of 2026-10-13, Today lists unfinished tasks from earlier days under «Atrasadas · N» (App/lib/screens/calendar_screen.dart:437-457 and :955-981), each from `Task.overdueOn` (App/lib/models/task.dart:453): an open task whose planned day, or deadline day without one, is before today, and a repeating task by its latest missed repetition. So with 6 tasks in Today, 2 of them overdue, «Marca como hechas todas las de hoy» offers «Marcar 4 tareas como hechas», and the next morning the 2 are still «Atrasadas»; «Pasa todo lo de hoy a mañana» leaves them behind too, and no line mentions them: «Tengo seis en Hoy y me dice “Marcar 4 tareas como hechas”. ¿Y las dos de arriba?». A single «Ya he…» already takes the repetition Today lists as overdue (task_matcher.dart:184-192).

Today's day is Calendar's. `TaskMatcher.bulk` gains `DateTime? now` (default `DateTime.now()`), as `TaskMatcher.targets` has (:209-215). `planBulk` (App/lib/services/bulk_plan.dart:159-172), `resolveCommand` and `_resolve` (App/lib/widgets/capture_command_cards.dart:153-301; `planBulk` at :245-250) pass it on, and `_views` (App/lib/screens/voice_task_screen.dart:3078-3096) passes `ref.read(calendarClockProvider)()` (App/lib/providers/calendar_focus_provider.dart:36), the clock Today reads (calendar_screen.dart:76). Pass the same `now` to the two `TaskMatcher.targets` calls in `_resolve` (:256-270), so one task's completion and a set agree on today.

The rule, in `bulk`, only when `target.status` is `open`, `target.undated` is false and `from` = `to` = today: (1) a task that doesn't repeat and that `task.overdueOn(today)` returns (as Calendar's `_overdueOn` uses it) is taken; (2) a repeating task: when completing (`completing`; the set already takes its repetitions today, :350-361), its `overdueOn(today)` repetition is taken too, beside today's; otherwise it's left out and counted with the other repeating tasks (`repeatingTasks`), once, even when it also repeats today; (3) everything else the set does still applies to them: notes and put-away projects left out, the project and the person named, whose tasks (`_inSet`), only what the person can edit (else `viewOnly`), and the words (`_ranked`, :389-394: rank them with the rest); (4) order: these first, oldest first by `displayDate ?? displayDeadline`, as Today lists them (calendar_screen.dart:450-455), then today's tasks in the set's order as now. Return which entries came in this way (for example their keys, as `BulkItem.key` writes them), and have `planBulk` mark those items (for example `BulkItem.overdue`). Update the doc comments of `bulk` (:296-311) and of `BulkPlan`.

No other set changes: «ayer», «lo atrasado» (`to` = yesterday), a week, `status` completed («las completadas de hoy») or any, `undated`, `find` («¿qué tengo hoy?», `TaskMatcher.find`) and one-task targets keep their rules.

The row: a marked item's day goes through the existing `overdueDate` («{date} · Atrasada» / “{date} · Overdue” / «{date} · Endarrerida»; app_es.arb:315, app_en.arb:545, app_ca.arb:294), then the project, the person and «Completada» as now. Give `_taskDetails` (capture_command_cards.dart:1064-1083) an `overdue` flag that wraps its day part (`taskDayLine`, or `taskDeadlineLabel` for a task with only a deadline), and pass it from the set row (:2056-2063): «mar, 20 oct · Atrasada»; «mié, 21 oct · 19:30 · Atrasada» for a missed repetition; «Vence mié, 21 oct · Atrasada» for a task with only a deadline. Marked rows are ticked like every row and can be unticked. Only marked items say «Atrasada» («Pasa todas las tareas de ayer a mañana» doesn't); `_FoundRow` doesn't change. The heading, the live count, the button and the left-out line need no code change: «Marcar 5 tareas como hechas», «Mover 5 tareas a mañana, vie 23». No new copy.

Where Calendar lands. `_apply` (voice_task_screen.dart:3422) lands on the earliest day among the tasks added, changed and marked done (:3651-3657), and names the other days with «también…» (:3753-3766). A marked item completed or changed in place would make Calendar jump back to its old day, with «· también en otros N días». Instead, a marked item's landing day before today counts as today, where Today listed it: it isn't the landing day and isn't named in «también…». One moved to a day lands there, as now. So «Marca como hechas todas las de hoy» ends on Today, with no «Atrasadas» left, today's rows ticked and lit, and «5 tareas completadas · Deshacer».

How it fits with D4 (open, this plan): a move by days («retrasa todo lo de hoy un día») moves each marked item by that many days from its own day, the contract's shift rule as written. Don't special-case it until the owner answers.

Tests your change rightly breaks: App/test/bulk_voice_commands_test.dart 'UX-1711: «Marca como hechas todas las de hoy»: Calendar stays on today, the 4 rows ticked and lit, «4 tareas completadas»' (:3056): its daily «Clase de yoga» began 7 days ago, so yesterday's missed repetition now joins the set. Give the class yesterday's repetition as done (`completedDates`), so the test keeps checking the landing it was written for. `_set` (:389-399) names the record type `TaskMatcher.bulk` returns: add the new field there. The selection tests use yesterday's sets and stay as they are.

Previews: add `cards.bulk-today-overdue` (es 1×, es 2×, ca 2×): normalDay() (App/test/ux_previews/support/fixtures.dart:130-184) plus two tasks Today lists as overdue, «Devolver el libro a la biblioteca» dated two days ago and «Pagar la factura del gas» with only a deadline yesterday, and «Marca como hechas todas las de hoy»: «Marcar 6 tareas como hechas», those two first, each «… · Atrasada». Add `applied.bulk-today-overdue-applied` (es 1×): after the tap, Calendar on today with no «Atrasadas», and «6 tareas completadas». Keep `cards.bulk-complete`'s description true.
acceptance: TaskMatcher.bulk and planBulk, with `now` fixed to a Thursday at 12:00, over: A (open, dated two days ago), B (open, only a deadline, yesterday), C (done, dated yesterday), D (open, today at 9:00), E (open, today, no time), G (daily at 8:00 since 7 days ago, nothing done), a note dated yesterday, and H (open, dated yesterday, in a project the person only views). A pending «hoy» completion set holds A, then B, then G's yesterday repetition, and after them today's D, E and G's repetition today; C, the note and H are not in it; A, B and G's yesterday repetition are marked overdue, and the others aren't.
The same tasks, a pending «hoy» move (`date` tomorrow): A and B first, marked, then D and E; G is left out and counted once (`repeatingTasks` is [G]).

Unchanged: a «hoy» set with `status` completed or any takes neither A nor B; a set for yesterday holds what it held before this change; with `now` on another day, the same «hoy» rule works from that day.

Widget, Spanish, 1× on 360×800: with A and B and three open tasks today, «Marca como hechas todas las de hoy» shows «Marcar 5 tareas como hechas»; the first two rows read «<two days ago, weekdayDate> · Atrasada» and «Vence <yesterday, weekdayDate> · Atrasada», both ticked; unticking A makes the heading and the button read «Marcar 4 tareas como hechas».

Then, with all five ticked, the tap: Calendar shows today with no «Atrasadas» heading, today's three rows ticked and lit, and the message reads «5 tareas completadas» with Deshacer and no «también»; Deshacer reopens the result, and all five are open again.

«Pasa todo lo de hoy a mañana» over the same tasks: «Mover 5 tareas a mañana, <tomorrow, E d>», A and B listed first with «Atrasada»; after the tap all five are on tomorrow (B by its deadline, P231), and the message reads «5 tareas movidas al <tomorrow, weekdayDate>».
At 2× on 360×800, in Spanish and in Catalan («… · Endarrerida»), the marked rows wrap whole, with nothing clipped.
«¿Qué tengo hoy?» (`find` with `from` = `to` = today) still lists only today's tasks.
deviceChecks: Main session, real model: «Marca como hechas todas las de hoy» and «Pasa todo lo de hoy a mañana» come back as sets with `from` = `to` = today and `status` open.
Owner's phone, Spanish, largest font: with a task left over from yesterday, «Marca como hechas todas las de hoy» lists it first with «Atrasada»; after the tap, Today has no «Atrasadas».

packages.title: The day of a move is a chip that opens «Elegir día», on the set card and on one task's card (D3)
brief: Context: run 2026-10-21-changes, plan 2. You carry out the owner's D3 of 2026-10-21 (evening), «Yes, on both cards» (DECISIONS.md, «Bulk commands: D1–D3»): the day in a move's heading becomes a chip («mañana, jue 22 ▾») that opens the existing «Elegir día» sheet, on the set card and on one task's change card; the count stays live. Contract: Backend/docs/VOICE_COMMANDS.md, «The card», the heading's chip (8e4513f). Builds on P231 (a task with only a deadline moves its deadline, and `UpdatePlan` says so with a flag).

UX-1716 (S2, review A's Q2). If «a mañana» was misheard, the card's only fix is «Volver a decirlo»: a whole new dictation, and without Pro one of the 10 a month. The one-task change card has the same gap. Saying it again fixed 35% of recognition errors, against 75–87% by touch or typing (VO-6; Suhm, Myers & Waibel 2001); U4 made a new task's date a tappable row for this reason. It also serves UX_REVIEW §7's task 5, «Move the doctor to Saturday».

A day picked is a change, as if it had been said. `TaskChanges` (App/lib/models/capture_command.dart:220-339) gains `movedTo(DateTime day)`: the same changes with `date` set to that day (as `_dayKey`, :25-26, writes it) and `shift_days` taken out; every other key stays, a `time` said included. `CaptureCommand.copyWith` (:537-575) gains `TaskChanges? changes`. The card calls `onChanged(command.copyWith(changes: command.changes.movedTo(day)))`, so the capture keeps it (`toJson`), and the heading, the list, the count, the button, the plan and the message after the tap all follow from the new day with no other code. Deshacer brings the result back as it was before the tap, with the day picked.

The sheet is the existing «Elegir día»: `editSchedule(context, date: <the day shown>, hasTime: false, title: l.pickDay, dayOnly: true)` (App/lib/widgets/schedule_editor.dart:23-43; the new-task form opens it so, App/lib/widgets/task_editor.dart:326-335): Hoy and Mañana, then the calendar; the day shown starts selected; a tap applies and closes; dismissing changes nothing. A move's day can't be «Sin fecha»: add `bool noDate = true` to `editSchedule` and `_ScheduleEditor`, offer the «Sin fecha» chip (:264) only when it's true, and pass `noDate: false` from the move chip. Every other caller keeps its sheet as it is.

The chip is an `ActionChip` like the project and person chips (App/lib/widgets/task_list_picker.dart:287-306; App/lib/widgets/task_assignment_picker.dart:100-130): its label, then ▾ (`Icons.arrow_drop_down_rounded`, size 18), `tooltip: l.pickDay` («Elegir día» / “Pick a day” / «Tria un dia»), and `onPressed: null` while the card is disabled (`enabled` false, while the result applies or closes). Its tap target is at least 48 dp tall. A long label wraps rather than being cut (`softWrap`, maxLines 2), as the project question's chips do (capture_command_cards.dart:581-594).

packages.title: The Voz privacy paragraph says in plain words why your words go to Google
brief: Context: run 2026-10-21-changes, plan 2. Passed on by the website review of 2026-10-21 (.claude/ux-web/runs/2026-10-21-changes/review-F.md:317, «App-side, for /ux»; that run's plan.md, «For the app's /ux loop»): the site's privacy summary now says your words go to Google's AI «to add, find or change tasks» (WEB-1002), but the app's own paragraph still says something narrower, in jargon.

UX-1720 (S1). `capturePrivacy` (App/lib/l10n/app_en.arb:523, app_es.arb:306, app_ca.arb:285), shown only at the end of Ajustes › Otros ajustes › Voz (App/lib/screens/voice_settings_screen.dart:196-206), says in its second sentence «La extracción de tareas con IA necesita internet y envía tus palabras a Google.» «Extracción» is jargon (plain language, ISO 24495-1; U11's renames), and since the voice commands a dictation also finds, changes, completes and deletes tasks, so «task extraction» no longer says what the words are sent for (PV-1: say plainly and accurately when words go to the AI provider). The capture sheet's first-use line, `capturePrivacyLine` («Tus palabras van por internet. Más en Ajustes.»), sends people here.

Fix: replace only the second sentence, in all three catalogs. EN “AI task extraction still needs the internet and sends your words to Google.” → “To add, find or change tasks, your words go over the internet to Google’s AI.” ES «La extracción de tareas con IA necesita internet y envía tus palabras a Google.» → «Para añadir, buscar o cambiar tareas, tus palabras van por internet a la IA de Google.» CA «L’extracció de tasques amb IA necessita internet i envia les teves paraules a Google.» → «Per afegir, cercar o canviar tasques, les teves paraules van per internet a la IA de Google.» (the organizer's Catalan, following the site's «per afegir, cercar o canviar tasques»; a native read is welcome). The first, third and fourth sentences stay word for word; App/test/localization_catalog_test.dart:565-581 checks the last.

Add an `@capturePrivacy` description to app_en.arb (it has none): the full voice privacy note at the end of the Voice screen in Settings: on-device or online transcription, why the words go to Google's AI, saved audio, and what stays on the phone; `capturePrivacyLine` is its short form in the capture sheet.

Why these words: the verbs are the site's privacy summary's, so the app and the site say the same; «cambiar» covers moving, completing and deleting, as on the site; «van por internet» repeats the capture sheet's own line.
Don't touch: `capturePrivacyLine`, the Voz screen's layout, `diagnosticsEvent` (its “extraction” is on the developer-only diagnostics screen, D13 of 2026-10-13), and the website.
Previews: re-render settings/voice. (voice.on-phone es 1× and 2×, voice.not-on-phone ca 2×).
acceptance: In EN, ES and CA, `capturePrivacy`'s second sentence is exactly the new one, the paragraph contains none of «extracción», «extracció» or “extraction”, and its other three sentences are unchanged.

Voz in Spanish at 2× on 320×640: after scrolling, the paragraph shows whole, with «Para añadir, buscar o cambiar tareas, tus palabras van por internet a la IA de Google.», and nothing overflows; the same in Catalan at 2×.
`capturePrivacy` is still used only by the Voz screen (App/test/voice_settings_test.dart:655 passes).
deviceChecks: A native Catalan read of «Per afegir, cercar o canviar tasques, les teves paraules van per internet a la IA de Google.»

decisions.question: «Retrasa todo lo de hoy un día»: where do the overdue tasks go? (UX-1721, S1; raised by the organizer while planning your D2; no reviewer has seen it on screen.) With your D2, a set «de hoy» also takes the tasks Today lists under «Atrasadas». A move to a day («pasa todo lo de hoy a mañana») sends them all to that day. But a move by days («retrasa todo lo de hoy un día») moves each task by that many days from its own day, as the contract's shift rule says: a task overdue since Monday goes to Tuesday, still before today, so it stays under «Atrasadas» after you said to put today's things off by a day. (a) Keep the contract's rule: each task moves from its own day. (b) The overdue tasks a «hoy» set takes move from today, so «un día» puts them on tomorrow with the rest.
decisions.recommendation: (b). «Hoy» is what Today shows (your D2), and Today shows those tasks as today's, so a move by days counts from today for them. Nothing else changes: sets of other days, one task, and a move to a day stay as they are, and a task with only a deadline moves its deadline the same way (D1). The card lists each of them with «Atrasada» before the tap, and Deshacer undoes it. P232 builds (a), the contract as written, until you answer; (b) would be one small package and one line in the contract. Reversible.
